test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 1 Aug 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
**Identify the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the given sentence.**

She holered at her manager and told her that she does not need her service.
solution:
The correct answer is "**holered**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence has a spelling error, which is "**holered**".
 
• The correct spelling of the word is "**hollered**", which means** to shout or call out loudly.**
 
• The other words in the sentence, such as "**manager**", "**need**", and "**service**", are spelled correctly.
 
• Thus, ***option 3*** is the incorrectly spelled word.

 

**Correct sentence**__**:** "*She __**hollered**__ at her manager and told her that she does not need her service."*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Manager**: a person responsible for controlling or administering all or part of a company or similar organization.
 
• **Need**: require (something) because it is essential or very important.
 
• **Holler**: (of a person) give a loud shout or cry.
 
• **Service**: the action of helping or doing work for someone.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

 
• Manager: एक कंपनी या समान संगठन के सभी या हिस्से को नियंत्रित करने या प्रशासित करने के लिए जिम्मेदार व्यक्ति।
 
• Need: आवश्यकता (कुछ) क्योंकि यह आवश्यक या बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है।
 
• Holler: (किसी व्यक्ति का) जोर से चिल्लाना या रोना।
 
• Service: किसी की मदद करने या उसके लिए काम करने की क्रिया।
